tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal yang dag sgrub mchod kyi phyag len gyi rim pa tho yig mi dbang sa skyong dges ba'i mchod rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhi/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa'i sgrub mchod gnang ba'i phyag len la/ dpal chen po'i gtor ma rdo rje phur pa dang mthun pa sogs gshoms kyi bya ba rnams sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i rdul mtshon dang ras bris la rten pa'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs sogs nas gsal bar 'byung ba bzhin ma 'khrul bar byas la/ cho ga dngos la/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma dpon slob kun gyis sgrigs nas mdzad/ gnas yo byin rlabs phur pa bzhin gyi rjes su/ rnga byin 'bebs tshan pa drug po gang rigs mdzad rjes/ skyabs 'gro nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyangs ring du bskrad zhes pa'i bar phur pa bzhin mdzad la/ de nas/ sdug cing sdang sems sogs dang sngags rnams bzla bar rol mo mdzad pa phur pa bzhin/ de nas/ hūm̐ khro bo sogs dang / hūm̐ nga'i dkyil 'khor sogs la spro na/ steng yang ma 'jug srung 'khor rdzogs pa yan sgrigs la tshogs zhing spyan drangs rjes rnga brdung mi mdzad/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs tshig gnyis ma la bhyoḥ dang hūm̐ 'dren rjes la/ dang po phud mchod kyi dbyangs bcug na yong bar sems/ de nas 'phags mchog ma'i mgor rol mo bcams nyis brdeg lan bcas blangs la/ dbyangs dang 'jug gi rol mo chems sogs phur pa bzhin/ de nas sman rag gtor gsum byin rlabs mdzad par mchod g.yog pas bskul ba dang dpon slob rnams kyi bsgrigs nas mdzad pa sogs phur pa bzhin la/ sngags gsum la gdangs phur pa bzhin mdzad/ de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum sgom pa nas bsgrigs te gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i bar phur pa bzhin/ de nas gzhal yas khang skyed pa'i bskyed dbyangs phur pa bzhin bya ba nas/ ru lu brjod pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad/

de nas rol mo chems brdung dang nyis brdeg lan bcas blangs la/ gtso bo bskyed pa'i tshig bzhi la dbyangs khor gnyis rol mo dang bcas pa phur pa bzhin/ rdo rje kha traṃ zhes pa nas ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs/ zhes pa'i bar la/ sgeg cing ma thung ba'i dbyangs dang mjug tu rol mo gsum brdung lan can/ de nas/ oṃ badzra kro ti shwa ri hūm̐/ zhes pa rnga brdung dang bcas bsgrigs la/ yum chen khro mo sogs tshig bcad gcig la phur pa bzhin dbyangs rol/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga nas 'khyud pas bzhugs kyi bar sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang rol mo byed/ shar du gaṃ las zhes pa nas tshig drug la dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol/ byang du baṃ las zhes pa nas/ dbus na bzhugs kyi bar la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang rol mo mdzad/ de nas rnga brdung bzhag la/ rang lus rten dang brten par zhes pa nas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor badzra sa ma dzaḥzhes pa'i bar sgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas rol mo bcams ma gsum brdeg lan bcas blangs la/ sems nyid ye shes sogs tshig bcad gcig la ser skyems kyi dbyangs dang mjug tu rol mo gsum brdeg dang chems brdung gi bar la sngags 'don/ de nas gsum brdeg lan bcas/ de nas gsal ba mi 'gyur sogs tshig bcad gcig la yang dag don bsdu'i dbyangs dang rol mo/ rtog med spros bral sogs la'ang dbyangs rol yang dag don bsdu bzhin byas la/ de nas rnga rol bzhag te snying kha'i hūm̐ las zhes pa nas/ rigs lnga yab yum gyi dbur rgyan zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ badzra shrī zhes pa nas/ shwa ri a zhes pa'i bar sgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas/ bcom ldan dpal chen sogs la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs ring ba dang rol mo gsum brdeg lan can gyi mjug tu chems brdung dang che ba gnyis brdeg de nas/ sgeg phreng glu gar sogs phur pa bzhin/ rang byung dbyangs bcas/ gdod nas sngags bcas phur pa bzhin bsgrigs la/

byang 'khril ba'i mchog chen dbyangs/ chub mchog tu sogs dang / rtog med spros bral sogs nas/ kha hī kha hī zhes pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas/ rnga brdung dang bcas rmad du byung ba'i sogs tshig bcad gcig la gu drag gi bla med mchod pa'i dbyangs 'jug mjug tu rol mo gsum brdeg chems brdung gi bar la sngags 'don/ de nas che ba gnyis brdeg rakta dmar gyi sogs la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang rol mo gsum brdeg gi rjes la chems brdung de'i rjes su dad ring gi mgo'i rol mo brgyad brdung che chung 'bab 'jog sogs phyag len bzhin byas la/ bde gshegs mnyam nyid sogs tshig bzhi la dad ring dbyangs khor gnyis rol mo dang bcas mdzad/ rnam dag sku la sogs la bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs rol 'jug me long mnyam nyid nas/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar la dpal gyi pho nya thung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mo mdzad/ dpal chen 'khor bcas zhes pa nas/ thob par shog gi bar la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang mjug tu rol mo gsum brdeg lan bcas/ chems brdung gi rjes su che gnyis brdeg de nas rol mo rnams bzhag snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin zhes pa nas/ rang la thim zhes pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas dpal chen thugs kyi zhes pa nas/ ma tshogs sprin dang skar ltar 'phros zhes pa'i bar/ gu drag gi thugs kha'i phyag rdor sogs kyis gdangs ring tsam byas la 'jug de nas/ hūm̐ chen nyi zla sogs nas bskul mtshams gcig byas la/ de nas/ tshad med zhes pa'i bar la gdangs de kha 'jug yang bhyoḥni gnas 'gyur zhes pa la bskul mtshams gcig byas/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐ zhes pa yan la gdangs de kha cung thung ba zhig bcug la/ de nas/ ru lu gsum brgya dang / kro ti shwa ri brgya rtsa/ 'khor rnams nyer gcig re bzlas/ de nas bzlas pa bsdus rjes/ yig brgya lan gsum/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/

de gtso bo yab yum la thim zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ de nas sa lha phur pa bzhin la/ rol mo bsgrigs 'don gdangs sogs phur pa bzhin mdzad la/ lha sta gon la/ a mṛ tas bsang ba nas tsam rten dang brten par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ ye shes bstims la/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs kyi rigs lnga re res dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar yan rnga rol med pa sogs bsgrigs 'don gang 'grig phur pa'i lha sta gon dang dbyibs 'dra bar mdzad la/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs/ phyi mchod nang mchod de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pa'i/ bde gshegs mnyam nyid zhes pa nas/ lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod la/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas snyan gsan dbab pa kye rdor bzhin dang / dpal ldan bla ma nas/ stsal du gsol gyi bar dril bu rgyun dkrol sa lha bzhin mdzad/ de rjes bum bskyed sgrig lugs phur pa sgra ji bzhin dang / de nas gtor bsngo bskang so sogs nas gtor 'bul grub pa yan chad spyi dang 'dra ba mdzad la/ mjug chog gi sgrig lugs gzhan phur pa bzhin la bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i sogs dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang dge ba sogs bsngo ba rnams bsgrigs nas bya'o/ de yan gyis sta gon gyi cho ga'i sgrig rim mdo tsam bstan zin to/ da ni sgrub mchod dngos gzhi'i phyag len bshad par bya ste/ de'ang / gshoms kyi tshogs ni ras bris rdul tshon gang la brten na'ang de dang 'brel ba'i yig cha nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ de nas sgrub pa po rnams gral la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung bzlas pa bsdus te dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar gzhan sta gon bzhin la/ gdan bskyed pa'i rjes su/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gdan steng du 'bab lugs la tshig zur cung zad bsgyur ba sogs/

mdor na bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i tshul gyi bsgrub tshul dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ rgyud 'debs mdzad na skabs 'dir mdzad/ de nas rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis pa'i skur 'gyur te phyi rol gtor ma stong ba'i bsgrigs 'don rnga brdung dbyangs rol sogs phur pa sgra ji bzhin dang / nang du log du log te rol mo'i bar bskor ba mdzad pa'ang phur pa bzhin/ de rjes cho ga nyin re la tshar gnyis re mdzad na snga chog dang / tshar re mdzad na dngos gzhi dang po'i nyin ma rtogs phyi ma rnams la sta gon gyi skabs bzhin gyis bum skyed mdzad/ de nas bdag 'jug la ji ltar bltams pa nas bzung / gtang rag gi maṇḍal yon 'bul ba yan chad la tshig rigs rnams sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i sgrub mchod byed tshul gyi ngag 'don gyi tho nas byung ba'i nang bzhin dang / bsgrigs 'don mdzad lugs rol mo dril sil sogs thams cad kye rdor dang phur pa'i bdag 'jug gi skabs su ji ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len bzhin mdzad pas chog par snang zhing sngags 'chang chen po'i tho yig der ye shes dbab pa kye rdor bzhin gsungs 'dug kyang / nged rang zhal ngo rnams kyi phyag len bzhin/ phur pa bzhin mdzad pas de bzhin bde ba yong bas dgongs zhugs zhu bzhin/ mi bskyod pa'i dbang gi sangs rgyas kun gyis bum pa'i dbang sogs la che ba'i yon tan ma'i gdangs bcug pas khyab par mchis/ bdag 'jug grub nas gtor bsngo bskang gso mjug chog sogs spyi dang mthun par mdzad/ sta gon dngos gzhi sogs gang la yang tshogs 'khor mdzad nas/ phur pa bzhin gtor 'bul gyi gong / rdor glu bkra shis sogs kyi dril sil grub rjes/ oṃ dra byaṃ sde shwi rda ni sogs dang / de rjes rol mo bcams bcad nas/ spyan 'dren mchod pa bshags pa rnams la rol mo gdangs sogs/ gu drag gi tshogs 'khor lugs bzhin mdzad/

'di'i mchod pa'i skabs su/ a la la ho bzhes su gsol lo zhes pa'i rjes su rol mo len/ tshogs zhu ba ni gu drag bzhin/ mjug chog gi bkris rol mo grub rjes mchod g.yog pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsol tshogs khyer la/ ho bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon dang sogs gdangs dang bcas par gu drag bzhin dpon slob kun gyis mdzad la tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma nyin re bsdud phur pa bzhin sgrub mchod nyi ma snga ma rnams la gshegs pa'i rol mo grub rjes thun gtor 'bul ba mdzad/ nub tha ma'i tshe gu drag bzhin tshogs 'khor grub 'phral ling ga gu drag ltar bcos pa la dgug gzhug sgrub thabs bzhin lan gsum mdzad rjes/ rol mo chems brdung de kha'i ngang nas slob dpon gyi phur pa blangs la rol mo dgu brdung gcig bya zhing / slar yang chems brdung ngos phur bu 'debs pa sgral gris liṅga btub pa gu drag bzhin mdzad la rol mo bzhi brdung blangs te/ bla ma la sogs tshig bcad gcig la phyi nang gsang ba ma'i dbyangs rol dang mjug tu chems brdung dang che ba gnyis brdeg de nas dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ma ltar na/ skabs 'dir sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gyi tshogs bkye bsdu dang lhag ma btang ste/ de nas steng du gtor 'bul bstan skyong sogs mdzad la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol byed tshul/ tho yig nas 'byung ba ltar dang / ras bris ltar na/ liṅga sgral mchod kyi rjes su mjug chog gtang / tshogs la longs spyad cing lhag ma byas la/ de nas steng du gtor 'bul bstan skyong rgyas par byas na legs sems so/ bstan skyong la/ ho bod khams sogs nas sgrig lugs sogs phur pa bzhin la mgo'i rol mo gcom pa dang tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis nam rdzogs la dbyangs phur pa bzhin gyi rjes su rol mo thog mar bzhi brdung dgu brdung / yang bzhi brdung sogs phur pa bzhin/ thams cad kyi rjes su chems brdung sogs phur pa dang 'dra bar mdzad do/

'di nyid kyi rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa'i gang zag ni/ rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin zhing / 'di nyid dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa zhig gi byar rung ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung las 'byung ba bzhin shin tu 'thad par sems te/ dper na gsang sngags gsar 'gyur gyi ma rgyud dang / gnyis med rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bde kye sogs mchog sgrub pa'i lha gang yang rung ba zhig gi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas/ gsang sngags sogs pha rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon byar rung ba dang tshul mtshungs pa sems shing / spyir yang dag 'di nyid rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la brten pa'i man ngag zab mo khyad par can par snang ste/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba 'ga' zhig dang 'bel gtam mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gi zer ma rnams chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyi bkod pa'i yi ge las/ 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po ba'i drung du/ gsang sngags rnying zhus lan gnang byung ba la/ nged kyi chos rjes bzang 'phags pas cis kyang nyon gsung nas/ nges kyang rgyud gsang rnying sogs dang khro bo dam pa rgyan/ zhi ba rin chen dra ba la sogs gzhung du ma nyan/ zhi ba 'di gsang rnying dang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud la brten par 'dug khro bo 'di gsang rnying dang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la brten par 'dug cing / gzhung 'di gnyis grub chen sangs rgyas gsang nas mdzad nges par snang / zhi ba rdo rje las rim dang khro bo rdo rje las rim gnyis kyang gzhung khyad du 'phags pa 'dug snying po bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha dzña na dha tu ma 'di/ sngags don bzang po rang gcig snang ste/ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ bo dhi tsitta byang chub kyi sems/ ma hā su kha bde ba chen po/ dzña na dha tu dbyings dang ye shes/

dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po zhes 'bod cing / bdag la yang de ltar rtog pa bskyed gcig pa/ a las sa bon yin tshod du 'dug ru lu ru lu bsgyur rgyu med/ gzungs kyi tshig zhes bya ba yin ste/ bde mchog pa'i nye snying lta bu'o/ ru lu 'di mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud nas mang du gsungs/ badzra kī li kī la ya rdo rje phur pa rdo rje phur pa zhes 'bod cing bskul/ bos nas ci byed na/ sarba bighnan baṃ bgegs thams cad chings shig hūm̐ sa bon/ phaṭ khos gcig pa yin/ spyir da lta gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum nas 'byung ba'i rgyud gsang 'dus sogs/ snga 'gyur gyis dus su byung ba'i rgyud rnam dag la/ rnying ma ba'i brda chad la/ sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud rdo rje bdud rtsi/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud karma ma la/ kha skong gi rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnams rgyud khyad du 'phags pa 'dug karma yā la nga yis ma mthong / sngon dus khyad 'phags gcig 'byung bar snang / yang dag 'di yang mnyam sbyor la brten pa'i man ngag khyad 'phags a tshi ba yin par 'dug me dgu ma mnyam sbyor gyi he ru kar rigs kyang lha dgu ma dang gcig tu 'dug dpyal rgyal pa 'di pas yang dag kye rdor lha grangs/ lha'i ming 'dra ba dgu ste/ zhen pa pho rus de gnyis la byed/ spyir rnying ma ba tsho chang gcig tshos/ yul dro na khru klog grang na rgyud rtsom zer bas lhad che/ de'i nang nas kyang rta mgrin gyi skor 'di lhad che/ gsar ma la phyag na rdo rje'i skor lhad che bar snang / 'on kyang khyed rang sa skya pa dang byas pa'i sngon gyi gsar ma ba chen po'i rjes su 'brang ba ma yin pa'i deng sang ci yin 'di yin med pa'i gsar ma ba la mang po gcig yod/ 'di rnams las rnying ma tsho ched kyi khyad 'phags/

bstan pa 'jig kha rnams su khong rnams rgyun ring zhing phan pa 'ong gsung / kun blos bkod do/ zhes 'byung ba yin la/ 'di lta bu'i dpal yang dag gi sgrub mchod gnang ba'i phyag len gyi rim pa 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can te 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rdo rje 'chang ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg mchog rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos myur ba bris te bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mi dbang bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po'i sde dang / bdag sogs bsod nams phun tshogs sku mched kyis gam pa lhun grub stag rtser/ yang dag gi sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs gnang tshe bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos gra chen po nas phul ba'o/ nged rang sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med yang phur 'di rnams la bshad sgrub gang byed kyang / thog mar sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i tho yig bla ma dam pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dkyil chog dang bcas pa de dag gi gsal byed sa lo sngags 'chang yab sras dang bcas pas bsgyur pa'i yig cha rnams te/ rdo rje phur pa'i phyogs la sgrub dkyil kyi gsung rab de rnams dang dpal yang dag gi phyogs la slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i rgya gzhung gis dgongs 'grel sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha la gam pa rin rgyal gyi mdzad pa'i me dgu dang me gcig gi sgrub thabs rnams dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog gi lhan thabs sogs dang / sa lo yab sras kyi mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha khyad par can rnams sogs mdor na yang phur gyi phyogs kyi sgrub dkyil kyi gsung rab de rnams la sbyang pa mthar phyin pa byas nas/

de dag gi rgyab rten du sa paṇa gyis rang 'gyur mdzad pa'i phur pa rtsa dum sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud/ slob dpon rnams gsum gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i 'grel chen 'bum nag tu grags pa dang / phur pa lam lhag lugs kyi rgyun 'dzin mi nyag bstan pa dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rtsa dum man ngag lugs kyi rnying pos don gsal zhes bya ba'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can de nyid dang / yang phur man ngag lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin dge sbyong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha dang / yang 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gsung brgyun bkod pa'i phur pa man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad dang / yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang bde legs kyis bsgrigs pa'i phur pa'i stod las/ smad las kyi yi ge gsar rnying gi tshogs su ma bsgrigs pa'i yig cha dang / bdag chen rgya gar pas phur pa lugs srol mang ba'i man ngag zab bsdus nye mkho rnams bsgrigs par mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi yig cha dang / blo ldan mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i phur pa sgra bzhi'i bshad pa/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim gyi rtsa ba dang / de'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon lam lhag gis mdzad pa'i phur pa'i stod 'bum du grags pa'i gsung rab dang / yang 'jam dbyangs jo sras ma'i lugs kyi phur pa rtsa ba gsum bsres kyi yig cha khyad par can dang / gzhan yang yang phur gyi bshad sgrub la mkho ba'i yi ge rnying ma du ma zhig kho bos mthong yang thams cad kyi ming 'dir 'dri bar ma nus la/ gang ltar yang phur gyi rgyud kyi don 'grel rnams bshad de rnams kyi nang du 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi lung dang de'i don bshad pa rnams la blo gros kyis zhib tu dpyad de/ yang phur gyi sgrub dkyil rnams dang sbyar te skal bzang don gnyer gyi dbus su bshad cing sgom don nyams su blangs na mchog mthun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub pa'i nges shes rnal 'byor pa gdod nas rang grol kho bos rnyed pa lags so/

'di bris dge bas rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ yab chos lhad med dpal gsang yang dag gis/ bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / bdag sogs phyi ma bde ba can bgrod shog/ //maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal yang dag sgrub mchod kyi phyag len gyi rim pa tho yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
